note: Real lines round Dongmyo at 1/4 (world metres, x east, z south, from src/core/seoul-grid.js toGame), from Yozi's OpenStreetMap export of 2026-11-10 (© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL), thinned to a point every few metres. Jong-ro is the line between its two carriageways; east of Jibong-ro it is drawn up to 4 m north of that (n says why). Jong-ro 58-gil, along the shrine's west wall, is drawn 3 m west of its line so the lane doesn't run on the wall.

roads.why: East of Jibong-ro the real centre line passes 4.5 m from the shrine's north-west corner; at game width (12 m) the road is moved up to 4 m north there (a big street may be off by up to 10 m).

shrine.en: Dongmyo Shrine (Seoul Donggwanwangmyo): its wall (OSM way 382454040), main gate (382454041) and Jeongjeon (336933496)
